definition: Percentage of orders that arrive in full, on-time, undamaged and with correct documentation. Counted at order level (an order fails if any line fails). Unlike some industry definitions it does not include invoice accuracy, and our on-time test uses the confirmed delivery slot rather than the requested date.
formula: (Orders delivered on-time AND in-full AND no damage AND correct docs) / Total orders * 100
data_source: Order management system + delivery confirmation + damage reports

definition: Average number of days to collect payment after invoice. Measures credit and collection efficiency.
formula: (Average Accounts Receivable / Daily Revenue) where Daily Revenue = Annual Revenue / 365

definition: Percentage of seasonal stock >180 days old marked down per inventory valuation policy.
formula: Stock value marked down / Total stock value * 100 where age >180 days
data_source: Inventory management system + stock age analysis

definition: Percentage of orders delivered both on the scheduled date and in the complete quantity requested.
formula: (Orders delivered on-time AND in-full) / Total orders * 100

definition: Total DC operating cost divided by units shipped from the DC. Includes direct, indirect and agency labour, energy, rent and facility costs and equipment maintenance; excludes outbound transport and inventory holding cost. Industry benchmark surveys often quote cost per order line or per case, and many exclude rent, so restate to the same basis before comparing.
formula: (labour + energy + rent and facility + equipment maintenance) / units shipped
data_source: GL cost centre actuals for DC cost centres CC-2101 to CC-2105 + WMS shipped units

kpi_name: DC labour cost per unit handled
definition: Direct, indirect and agency labour cost per unit shipped. The labour-only measure is the most comparable with other retail DCs because it does not depend on rent or energy contracts, and labour is the largest share of DC cost.
formula: (direct + indirect + agency labour cost) / units shipped
data_source: GL cost centre actuals (labour accounts) + WMS shipped units

kpi_name: DC productivity: units per labour hour
definition: Units picked and shipped per paid labour hour (direct plus indirect, including agency). Benchmarks usually use direct productive hours only, so ours reads lower than a benchmark quoted on direct hours.
formula: units shipped / total paid labour hours
data_source: WMS shipped units + workforce management paid hours

kpi_name: DC pick rate: lines per hour
definition: Order lines picked per direct picking hour, by pick method (each, case, goods-to-person). Compare only like for like by method and degree of automation.
formula: order lines picked / direct picking hours

definition: Percentage of order lines picked and shipped correctly (right SKU, quantity and condition). Measured at pack and by customer complaint.
formula: correct order lines / total order lines shipped * 100
data_source: WMS pack audit + customer service complaints
